title: Programme-level trial ledger: per leg/family, every configuration tested (N, effective N), DSR + Harvey-Liu haircut on every Stage-0 evidence record, data fingerprint on E5 records
note: [2026-10-16 RESEARCH-OPS-BENCHMARK-1016] GAP (benchmark docs/research/research-ops-benchmark-2026-10-16.md section 2, sources S2-S5, S7, S8.2, S18): we log trials but nothing COUNTS them.
